notes.title: Mega Fish Pack Update is Out!!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Mega Fish Pack Update is Out![/b][/h1]

Added 25 fish items with varying rarity. Brand new icon styling for all future items

Starter items (Mackerel and Atlantic Salmon) are rarity now, drop no more, and reserved for later use

[b]Future roadmap[/b]: more items, crafting and fusing system, session fish counter UI, in-game inventory access

[h3]Stay tuned![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320799/3a23b39fe9c5890ec1663cd5055481ea19463a4a.jpg[/img]
